finding_1_restore_approved_ph_rules.summary: Restored Phase 3C.4 approved baseline across all 19 crops. Excised universal pH exclusions (RULE-UNIVERSAL-SODICITY-01 at pH > 9.0 and RULE-UNIVERSAL-ACIDITY-01 at pH < 4.0) and VERIFIED_LETHAL_PH_LIMITS. All 19 crops evaluate as SOFT_PENALTY in Tier 1; pass with WARNING_ONLY when outside preferred range. Extreme chemical hostility (pH < 4.2 or pH > 9.0) handled in ranking where depressed suitability triggers NO_RECOMMENDATION_SUITABLE with 0 recommendations and Lime/Gypsum advisory.

finding_2_remove_unsubstantiated_stcr_ca.summary: Audited previous STCR calibration records. Until genuine multi-location field calibration trial source documents, verified coefficients, and official institutional validation are reviewed and approved, STCRCalibrationRegistry._APPROVED_CALIBRATIONS is strictly empty ({}). Query STCR requests fall back to BASELINE_RDF_ARITHMETIC with stoichiometric 18% DAP nitrogen credit deduction and unregistered ID notice.

finding_3_correct_provenance_verificatio.summary: Removed fake verification paths. Without active cryptographic PKI signature verification against a trusted public key, observations cannot be awarded INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED. Sourced inputs receive SOURCE_REFERENCED; user inputs receive USER_DECLARED. Outlined architectural specifications for future PKI implementation.

finding_4_restore_audit_artifacts_and_ch.summary: Validated phase_3c_4_2_hard_exclusion_evidence_audit.csv (61 downgraded candidate rules) and phase_3c_4_eligibility_rules.csv (0 HARD_EXCLUSION). Verified all 5 historical checksum manifests bitwise immutable. Fully preserved TEST-11 and TEST-18.

finding_5_fix_test_reporting_and_dynamic.summary: Replaced unconditional ALL_TESTS_PASSING with dynamic status calculation (overall_status = ALL_TESTS_PASSING only if failures == 0 and errors == 0, else FAILED). Verified through deliberate failure regression subtest that failure yields FAILED status.
